# `lumen-horizontal-stack-card`

Lumen · Horizontal stack: Cards side by side with equal widths, like HA's horizontal stack, with one max. width (px or %) for the whole group

- YAML: `type: custom:lumen-horizontal-stack-card`
- Default `grid_options`: `{"columns":12,"rows":"auto","min_columns":3}`
- Starting config: `{"cards":[]}`
- `cards` is a list of complete card configs (any HA card, each with its own `type`), not one object as its selector suggests.
- Editor: own `getConfigElement`: `title` and `cards` are edited in HA's stack editor, the other fields above it.
- Inner cards keep their own `visibility`.

| Field | Req | Selector | Allowed values | Default | Label | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` |  | text |  |  | Title |  |
| `cards` |  | object |  |  | Cards (YAML) | A list of card configs, as in a vertical stack |
| `max_width` |  | number (min: 1; max: 2000; step: 1) |  |  | Max. width | The card is never wider than this and stays centred in its place. Percent is of its place in the grid. Empty = the full width |
| `max_width_unit` |  | select | `px` (Pixels (px)), `%` (Percent (%)) | `px` | Width unit |  |
| `align` |  | select | `center` (Centre), `start` (Left), `end` (Right) | `center` | Position |  |
| `card_width` |  | select | `equal` (Equal), `content` (Fit content) | `equal` | Card width |  |
| `edit_note` |  | text |  |  | Edit-mode note | Shown only while editing the dashboard, e.g. "phone copy". Cards with a screen condition (their own or their section's) get a label in edit mode automatically |
| `styles` |  | text (multiline) |  |  | Custom CSS | CSS added to the card, e.g. .press { border-radius: 8px } |

## Reading the table

- Fields are in the order of the visual editor. `list[].field` is a field of each list item; `group.field` is nested under the key `group`.
- Starting config: `getStubConfig()` with no entities in reach; its entity ids are examples only, they do not exist on a real system.
- Default: only what the form or the card's `defaults()` declares. Empty does not mean no behaviour: the code may still fall back, e.g. to the entity's name or to a theme colour. Fallbacks: tables in README.md, "Settings of every card".
- `(YAML only)`: not in the visual editor, hand-kept from the source.
- Req: required by the form. "Config error with no options" shows what `validate()` rejects at runtime.
- Any card also takes Home Assistant's own `grid_options` and `visibility`.
- The base class reads `color_scheme`, `accent_color`, `glow_color`, `max_width`, `max_width_unit`, `weather_effects`, `styles`, `edit_note` and `haptics` on every card, also where the card's form omits them. Only the listed ones are meant for that card.
- `ui_color` takes a Home Assistant colour name, hex or rgb.
- `action` selectors (`ui_action`) take a Home Assistant action: `action` is one of `toggle`, `more-info`, `perform-action`, `call-service`, `navigate`, `url`, `assist`, `none`.
